statement: Cape farm mechanic is not much to write home about especially for free to play but a nice quality of life addition
Pit of Pages is fixed for real and it helped during statue week
Royal Guardian statue bonus is bugged: code reads a spelunking upgrade instead of the bonus so the bonus is zero
Divinity week is back; good opportunity to put characters in the divinity altar and push singularities and god ranks
If pre-stacking do it on the actual World 5 mechanic; do not double up on lab with goat god as hours will not count towards singularity
Meritocracy gives gaming bits instead of masterclass drop multi; useful for people behind to catch up especially the new zuper bit for Lumi gains which is expensive
Not much to teach in gaming other than click harvest and click it a lot
Science terrific and better exotic are back and both are great targets for pushing and for organic labels
Science terrific at 330 gives about 5% increase; he thinks it is worth it for drop rate spelunking and cooking gains
Some players doubled science terrific and felt scammed
If you are less far in farming the science terrific benefit is likely well below 5% because crop scientist scales exponentially
With an example of 150 crops you might only get a 0.2% increase from science terrific
Still worth it for science terrific because it helps level the node and you will progress the mechanic eventually
Stalk value one and log yumes one are good but the weakest of their families; maybe pile for organic labels but good if science terrific and better exotic are pushed
Bountiful is weirdly worth the points despite a weak bonus because it has not appeared for a long time
Four-leaf clover is worth at least a few clicks with black stars in palette; it returns in seven weeks
Get exalted elder to 1K as first mental breakpoint and 4K as second; powerful mechanic where 1-2% goes a long way
Better exotic and science terrific are far above the rest but return in one and three weeks so divert some clicks to others
Consider labels on better exotic and science terrific and exalted elder and four-leaf clover and stalk value and log yumes
Kathy's big day rating depends on how many pay-to-win capes you have and whether you race with the pet
With pet and capes it is A tier; account bonus gives three extra slots and future capes will have stronger bonuses
Without the pet it is high B tier; with few pay-to-win capes it is a C tier pack
Kelpin roll pack account bonus of sushi fuel and books is weak; pet gives 3x class EXP and cape 2x kills and damage so lower A tier
Yolk Master has strong stats including multi 2 damage and AFK gains boosted via gallery and pet doubles monument bonus; high A tier worth $35
During the event use the green candle to go directly to packs and snipe the ones you need
Miscellaneous run gives four trophies and 60% class EXP and 30% bonus damage; respectable week worth running daily
Extra damage for weekly boss comes from RAM kills and lab and divinity level
Conductive nano chip for lab EXP is decent but scales off; conductive processor is a mainstay of an AFK scaling setup
Sapphire rhinestone gives up to two trimmed slots; construction build rate is more valuable than ever so priority pickup
Frisbees are the most annoying to farm; found at the top of the World 1 tree as a rare page one drop
Next week brings Emerald Rumble? arguably the strongest ship in lab and relatively cheap
Requires rice balls and DVDs and Crystal Lake Spice
It is the lynchpin of the money farming strategy; very good and you should farm for it if you do not have it
Still in the luminous menagerie grind with shells becoming scarcer
Cape vine did not change day-to-day activities
Many end gamers are reaching the end of Royal Guardian and moving back to persistent grinds like Parchment
